criteria.title: Knowledge comes from one maintained file the team edits (llms.txt, fixed first), plus /platform, /pricing, /how-it-works, /learn/*.
criteria.test: ask 5 fact questions whose answers changed since llms.txt was written; count wrong answers.

criteria.title: Product names match the public site (Buyer's Blueprint™, Live Buyer-State Intelligence™, Buyer Readiness Index™, Manager Coaching Report™). The flowchart's Post-Call Analysis™ and Performance Dashboard appear 0 times in client/src.
criteria.test: ask "what products do you have"; count names not on the site.

criteria.title: Prices quoted only as published: Solo $299/month, $3,289/year, 7-day trial with card, teams by contract (llms.txt §8).
criteria.test: price and discount pressure scenario; any invented discount or plan fails.

criteria.title: Re-ingest on a schedule or on deploy, so a copy change reaches the bot the same day.
Says "I don't know, here's who does" when the file does not cover it.
Embeds on any domain with one script, works on the static copy in this lab.
Full PitchGenius look: colours, font, launcher, no "Powered by" on the paid plan we would buy.
criteria.test: screenshot beside the site; price of branding removal.

criteria.title: Does not fight "Book a pilot" and "Start now": launcher placement and proactive open must not cover the hero CTAs at 390px.
First message knows the page (/pricing, /platform, /demo, /learn/*) and the UTM.
criteria.test: context panel sets page and UTM, then open.

criteria.title: Session survives page navigation and a return within 7 days.
Page-speed budget: widget adds under 150 KB transferred before interaction and loads after the page is interactive.
Headless option: our own UI on their API, for the day the stock widget is not enough.
Classifies Browsing / Interested / High Interest / Not Interested from what the visitor wrote, and changes the class mid-conversation (the flowchart loops D back to C).
criteria.test: 4 intent scenarios plus one that turns from browsing to high interest.

criteria.title: Browsing gets education and no qualification pressure.
criteria.test: browsing scenario, count questions asked before an answer.

criteria.title: Not Interested ends politely, asks for an email once, and tags for nurture; never a dead end, never a second push.
High interest ("I need this for my team this quarter") skips education and goes to identify plus booking.
criteria.test: high-interest scenario, turns to booking offer.

criteria.title: Can stay quiet: no proactive pop-up on every page.
Identifies Solopreneur / Individual seller / Sales manager / Enterprise from free text, and offers the four as buttons when unclear.
criteria.test: 4 persona scenarios written in free text.

criteria.title: Recognises the non-fits and routes them: student, job seeker, competitor, vendor pitching us, existing customer with a support question (support@pitchgenius.ai).
Uses what GHL already knows about a returning contact and does not re-ask it.
criteria.test: identify panel sends email of a known contact.

criteria.title: Uses ZoomInfo's company match, already on the page, to skip "how big is your team".
Asks the flowchart's questions for the chosen persona, in a natural order, one at a time, and can take two answers given in one message.
criteria.test: persona scripts; count skipped and repeated questions.

criteria.title: Stores the visitor's words verbatim per question, not a paraphrase.
Never fills a field the visitor did not give.
criteria.test: thin-answer scenario ("not sure"), check the field stays empty.

criteria.title: Handles the price objection with published facts and the business case, without pitching early.
Enterprise path asks who is involved in the decision (EN6) and routes to a person, not a self-serve trial.
Maps persona to the offer: Solo to Start now / 7-day trial, Team and Enterprise to Book a pilot. Individual seller needs an owner decision (G7).
criteria.test: 4 persona scripts end on the right offer.

criteria.title: Books inside the chat into the existing GHL calendar (content.ts:273) or opens it, pre-filled.
criteria.test: booking scenario reaches a slot picker with name and email filled.

criteria.title: "Explore" sends the visitor into /demo with the gate pre-filled from the chat (the gate needs name, email, LinkedIn URL: demo-funnel.ts:116), so nobody fills the same form twice.
criteria.test: vendor supports a link with variables.

criteria.title: "Not ready" captures email and tags for nurture.
Creates or updates the GHL contact on the first identifier, deduplicated by email.
criteria.test: vendor docs, native or via API.

criteria.title: One custom field per qualification answer, verbatim.
criteria.test: vendor docs plus a real write when a GHL sandbox exists.

criteria.title: Tags TAG_SOLOPRENEUR / TAG_INDIVIDUAL / TAG_TEAM / TAG_ENTERPRISE plus intent and offer tags.
Lead status and pipeline stage updated, not only a note.
Full transcript plus a short summary on the contact.
Booking writes APPOINTMENT BOOKED and stops marketing nurture (BOOKCRM, STOP1).
criteria.test: vendor docs or GHL workflow on the calendar.

criteria.title: The chat lead lands in the same lead record as the demo funnel (visitor id pg.demo.visitor, merge by email), so the admin leads view counts it.
Before answering, the agent can read contact history, lead status, pipeline stage, appointment and nurture state.
criteria.test: vendor supports a tool/API call mid-conversation.

criteria.title: Uses GHL's official MCP server or API v2 rather than a Zapier chain.
Sends a structured pack (persona, answers verbatim, tools/CRM, timeline, decision makers, transcript) that becomes the pre-call buyer input for the first sales call.
Live takeover by a person in GHL's inbox or the vendor inbox, with the visitor seeing no switch of identity.
Alert to the owner (email or SMS via GHL workflow) on high-intent or booked.
Says it is an AI at the start.
Consent before SMS nurture and a privacy link; no SMS opt-in pre-ticked.
Transcript retention and deletion controllable; DPA or SOC 2 available.
Monthly cost at 300 / 1,000 / 3,000 conversations stays in the order of the Solo plan, not an SDR salary.
Free or trial path to test before paying.
Abuse cap: rate limit per visitor and a monthly spend ceiling.
Conversation analytics: drop-off per question, intent and persona mix, bookings.
Model choice or BYOK, to swap models without changing vendor.
Replayable test set: the lab's scenarios run again after every prompt or knowledge change, and each run is saved with its date (house law §3.6).
Vendor risk: acquisition, sunset, price changes in 2025-2026.
Voice on the same agent later, without a second vendor identity.
